text_en: It is necessary to boast; nothing is to be gained by it, but I will go on to visions and revelations of the Lord.
text_cn: 若必须夸耀──固然无益──我就来说说主的显现和启示。

text_en: I know a person in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know; God knows.
text_cn: 我知道有一个在基督内的人，十四年前，被提到三层天上去──或在身内，我不知道，或在身外，我也不知道，惟天主知道──

text_en: And I know that such a person—whether in the body or out of the body I do not know; God knows—
text_cn: 我知道这人──或在身内，或在身外，我不知道，天主知道──

text_en: was caught up into Paradise and heard things that are not to be told, that no mortal is permitted to repeat.
text_cn: 他被提到乐园里去，听到了不可言传的话，是人不能说出的。

text_en: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except of my weaknesses.
text_cn: 对这样的人，我要夸耀；但为我自己，除了我的软弱外，我没有可夸耀的。

text_en: But if I wish to boast, I will not be a fool, for I will be speaking the truth. But I refrain from it, so that no one may think better of me than what is seen in me or heard from me,
text_cn: 其实，即使我愿意夸耀，我也不算是狂妄，因为我说的是实话；但是，我绝口不谈，免得有人估计我，超过了他在我身上所见到的，或由我所听到的。

text_en: even considering the exceptional character of the revelations. Therefore, to keep me from being too elated, a thorn was given me in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, to keep me from being too elated.
text_cn: 免得我因那高超的启示而过于高举自己，故此在身体上给了我一根刺，就是撒殚的使者来拳击我，免得我过于高举自己。

text_en: Three times I appealed to the Lord about this, that it would leave me,
text_cn: 关于这事，我曾三次求主使它脱离我；

text_en: but he said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for power is made perfect in weakness. ” So, I will boast all the more gladly of my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may dwell in me.
text_cn: 但主对我说：“有我的恩宠为你够了，因为我的德能在软弱中才全显出来。”所以我甘心情愿夸耀我的软弱，好叫基督的德能常在我身上。

text_en: Therefore I am content with weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and calamities for the sake of Christ; for whenever I am weak, then I am strong.
text_cn: 为此，我为基督的缘故，喜欢在软弱中，在凌辱中，在艰难中，在迫害中，在困苦中，因为我几时软弱，正是我有能力的时候。

text_en: I have been a fool! You forced me to it. Indeed you should have been the ones commending me, for I am not at all inferior to these super-apostles, even though I am nothing.
text_cn: 我成了狂妄的人，那是你们逼我的。本来我该受你们的褒扬，因为纵然我不算什么，却一点也不在那些超等的宗徒以下。

text_en: The signs of a true apostle were performed among you with utmost patience, signs and wonders and mighty works.
text_cn: 宗徒的记号，也在你们中间，以各种的坚忍，藉着征兆、奇迹和异能，真正实现了；

text_en: How have you been worse off than the other churches, except that I myself did not burden you? Forgive me this wrong!
text_cn: 其实，除了我本人没有连累过你们这件事外，你们有什么不及别的教会之处呢？关于这个委屈，你们宽恕我吧！

text_en: Here I am, ready to come to you this third time. And I will not be a burden, because I do not want what is yours but you; for children ought not to lay up for their parents, but parents for their children.
text_cn: 看，这已是第三次我预备好，到你们那里去，我还是不连累你们，因为我所求的不是你们的东西，而是你们自己；原来不是儿女应为父母积蓄，而是父母该为儿女积蓄。

text_en: I will most gladly spend and be spent for you. If I love you more, am I to be loved less?
text_cn: 至于我，我甘心情愿为你们的灵魂付出一切，并将我自己也完全耗尽；难道我越多爱你们，就该少得你们的爱吗？

text_en: Let it be assumed that I did not burden you. Nevertheless (you say) since I was crafty, I took you in by deceit.
text_cn: 是啊！我没有连累过你们，但我是出于狡猾，以诡诈榨取了你们。

text_en: Did I take advantage of you through any of those whom I sent to you?
text_cn: 在我所打发到你们那里去的人中，难道我曾藉着其中的一位，占过你们的便宜吗？

text_en: I urged Titus to go, and sent the brother with him. Titus did not take advantage of you, did he? Did we not conduct ourselves with the same spirit? Did we not take the same steps?
text_cn: 我曾请求了弟铎，并打发了一位弟兄同去；难道弟铎占过你们的便宜吗？我们行动来往，不是具有一样的心神，一样的步伐吗？

text_en: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves before you? We are speaking in Christ before God. Everything we do, beloved, is for the sake of building you up.
text_cn: 到如今你们以为我是向你们申辩吧！其实，我们是在基督内当着天主的面说话；这一切，亲爱的，都是为了建树你们，

text_en: For I fear that when I come, I may find you not as I wish, and that you may find me not as you wish; I fear that there may perhaps be quarreling, jealousy, anger, selfishness, slander, gossip, conceit, and disorder.
text_cn: 因为我怕我来到的时候，见你们不合于我所想望的，你们也见我不合于你们所想望的：就是怕有争端、嫉妒、愤怒、分裂、毁谤、挑唆、自大、纷乱；

text_en: I fear that when I come again, my God may humble me before you, and that I may have to mourn over many who previously sinned and have not repented of the impurity, sexual immorality, and licentiousness that they have practiced.
text_cn: 又怕我到的时候，我的天主再使我在你们前受委屈，并为那许多从前犯了罪而不悔改他们所习行的不洁、淫乱和放荡的人而恸(tòng)哭。
